story_type: mother and daughter in the water after capsizing, basket hoist
hook: A mother and her daughter, in the water after their boat flipped.
narration: A mother and her daughter were in the water, after their boat flipped off the Georgia coast.
Their sixteen foot boat had run aground about a mile off St. Simons Island.
Then it started taking on water over the side, and they called the Coast Guard.
A rescue boat came, but the shallow water kept it two hundred fifty yards away.
[short pause] Then the boat capsized, and both of them went into the water.
A helicopter from Air Station Savannah lowered a rescue basket. You climb in, and the flight mechanic reels you up on the cable.
Both were wearing bright orange life jackets, which is how the crew spotted them from the air.
The first one rode the basket up to the door.
Then the basket went back down for the second.
outcome: The crew hoisted both women and flew them to St. Simons Island Airport.
title: Mother and daughter in the water off Georgia
description:
On July 31, 2015, a Coast Guard helicopter crew from Air Station Savannah hoisted a mother and her daughter from the water after their 16-foot boat capsized about a mile off St. Simons Island, Georgia, and flew them to St. Simons Island Airport.

Footage: U.S. Coast Guard video by Air Station Savannah, released by Coast Guard Public Affairs Detachment Jacksonville, via DVIDS: https://www.dvidshub.net/video/417571
